k:非.mnemonic: Two combs standing back to back, teeth pointing away from each other: two sides that refuse to face one another, each insisting the other is in the wrong. Injustice (not, un-, mistake).

k:銀.mnemonic: The metal that stubbornly (艮) refuses to be gold (金): it shines nearly as well, but always stands one step lower on the podium. Silver.

k:株.mnemonic: A farmer ties his cow (牛) to a tree (木) stump and sells shares in her milk to the neighbours. Stocks (stump, shares, stock).

k:視.mnemonic: The priest walks slowly round the altar (礻) to see (見) that every candle and cup is exactly in its place. Inspection (regard as, see, look at).

k:敗.mnemonic: You strike (攵) the shellfish (貝) with a hammer to open it and smash it to bits. No pearl, no dinner. Failure (defeat, reversal).

k:質.mnemonic: A buyer splits a shellfish (貝) open with an axe (斤) to see what it is really made of inside. Substance (quality, matter, temperament).

k:帯.mnemonic: Take the band tied round your forehead (冖), make it as wide as a towel (巾) and far longer, and wind it round your waist over the robe. Sash (belt, obi, zone).

k:被.mnemonic: He pulls a cloak (衤) over the stolen pelt (皮) to hide it, but the guard lifts a corner and the fine lands squarely on him. Incur (cover, veil, shelter).

k:修.mnemonic: The leader (亻) trims his whiskers (彡) at dawn and strikes (攵) the practice post a hundred times before breakfast, every single day. Discipline (study, master, learn).

k:草.mnemonic: Early (早) in the year, before any flowers (艹) open, the green blades are already pushing up everywhere. Grass (weeds, herbs, pasture).

k:裁.mnemonic: A blade as sharp as a halberd (戈) slices the cloth, the spare is gone (去), and what is left is a garment (衣) cut to fit you exactly. Tailor (judge, decision, decide).

k:破.mnemonic: Drag a pelt (皮) across a sharp stone (石) and it catches and rips right down the middle. Rend (rip, tear, break).

k:座.mnemonic: Under the canopy (广), a person (人) and a companion lower themselves onto the bare soil (土), knees bent, for want of a chair. Squat (seat, cushion, sit).
k:座.hint: Two on bare earth, knees bent.

k:芸.mnemonic: A craftsman unwinds a cocoon (厶) into silk and embroiders flowers (艹) so real that bees land on them. Technique (art, craft, performance).

k:停.mnemonic: The guard puts a hand to your forehead (冖): 'What (何) is your business here?' You go no further until you answer. Halt (stopping).

k:撃.mnemonic: A war car (車) rolls forward, and the soldier riding it raises a weapon (殳) in his hand (手) and charges. Attack (strike, beat, defeat).

k:却.mnemonic: The official stamp (卩) is gone (去) from the desk, so the clerk shrugs and signs the paper by hand in its place. Instead (on the contrary, rather, withdraw).

k:景.mnemonic: A clear day (日) over the capital (京): sun on the rooftops and towers, and everyone stops on the bridge to admire it. Scenery (view, see, look).

k:影.mnemonic: The low sun throws dark streaks, like whiskers (彡), across the scenery (景): the long shapes of everything standing in the light. Shadow (silhouette, phantom).

k:脚.mnemonic: After a month (月) on wheels that kept sinking in the snow, the plane is fitted with long runners underneath instead (却). Skids (leg, undercarriage, base).

k:航.mnemonic: On the boat (舟) the captain spreads the chart across the table (几) and plots the course with a ruler. Navigate (sail, cruise, fly).

k:験.mnemonic: Before buying, a person (人) in a hat (𠆢) opens the mouth (口) of the horse (馬) and counts its teeth, to check the seller told the truth about its age. Verification (effect, testing).

k:辺.mnemonic: A guard with a sword (刀) walks the path (辶) that circles the town, patrolling the land round about. Environs (boundary, border, vicinity).

k:比.mnemonic: Two people sitting side by side, facing the same way, so alike that you look from one to the other to see who is taller. Compare (race, ratio, Philippines).

k:及.mnemonic: A figure stretching forward with a long arm, fingertips just catching the back of someone running ahead. Reach out (exert, exercise, cause).

k:夏.mnemonic: In the heat you can barely drag your own self (自) along. You trudge (夂) down the baking road, wiping your brow. Summer.

k:督.mnemonic: He points his divining rod (卜) at the prefecture (県) team: 'Again! And you also (又)!' Nobody goes home until they get it right. Coach (command, urge, supervise).

k:級.mnemonic: Pupils of every lineage (系) reach out (及) for the next rung of the ladder. The rung you stand on is your grade. Class (rank, grade, position).

k:皆.mnemonic: Compare (比) the sheep after the snow: every one of them is white (白), without a single exception. All (everything, whole, entire).

k:階.mnemonic: A mound (阝) so tall that all (皆) the villagers cut steps into it and built a floor at each level. Storey (stair).
